# These actual CLI refusals precede credentials, state, snapshot and SSH.

stderr 'agent prebuilt'
effects

config '{"prebuilt":null}'
! skygo-ec2 -job $WORK/job -task $WORK/missing-task -workdir $WORK/missing-workdir
stderr 'agent prebuilt'
effects

config '{"source":"/src","prebuilt":{"path":"/missing/agent","commit":"1111111111111111111111111111111111111111","sha256":"2222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222"}}'
! skygo-ec2 -job $WORK/job -task $WORK/missing-task -workdir $WORK/missing-workdir
stderr 'exclusive'
effects

config '{"prebuilt":{"path":"/missing/agent","token":"DO_NOT_ECHO"}}'
! skygo-ec2 -job $WORK/job -task $WORK/missing-task -workdir $WORK/missing-workdir
stderr 'agent prebuilt'
! stderr DO_NOT_ECHO
effects
